topic: Material changes for a sports-business watchlist (DATA 260 HW11, s3319, domain 7): large daily price moves and new SEC 8-K filings
note: Approved-source allowlist: watch.py refuses any URL whose host is not listed here. Live prices come from the Yahoo Finance chart API and live 8-Ks from the SEC data.sec.gov submissions API, because from the Muse cloud computer (Nov 2026) Stooq returns a JavaScript bot check and the legacy browse-edgar URL returns HTTP 400. SEC asks automated clients to send a User-Agent with a contact email. MSGS was renamed MSGK on 2026-10-27 after the Rangers spin-off (same CIK). The *_demo sources are the kit's offline fixtures.
